notes: Missing direction or room emits C's exact format line.
An invalid first direction emits the valid-direction line but C continues with the default north exit and success confirmation.
Unknown room vnums emit the exact missing-room line.
An immortal creates paired bare exits and receives the exact confirmation.
The two-argument parser ignores text after the room number.
C one_argument lowercases uppercase direction input before the exact confirmation.
C two_arguments skips fill words before each argument.
The runtime helper leaves only the reciprocal bare destination and clears prior door metadata, matching C CREATE records.
A builder may not create an exit to a different zone and receives the target-zone refusal.
A builder with the current zone selected can create the paired exit.
A builder whose saved OLC zone differs from the current zone receives the current-zone refusal.
